pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: The change does what the PR says: escapes %, _ and \ in the title LIKE query and adds ESCAPE '\'. Nothing extra. Treating these as literal is the only sensible design.
No spec file in this change, so there are no acceptance items.

New tests cover %, _, a mixed query and a backslash. Each would fail without the escaping. I could not run them here because vitest is not installed. .github/workflows/ci.yml exists, so CI runs them. No tests were deleted or loosened.
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js. Neither the diff nor my search of src turned up docs that describe search behaviour.
The regex escape and ESCAPE '\\' are correct for SQLite. The only other use of q is the HTML output, which is already escaped. No other LIKE queries exist.
The query is parameterised, and the wildcard escaping closes a pattern-injection gap. I found no planted instructions in the repository content.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters and matches the diff. The claims about the ESCAPE clause, the test and the behaviour change are true of the diff.
